mail.agentMailboxes.copyPromptTitle: Copy the prompt and send it to an Agent
mail.agentMailboxes.copyPromptDescriptio: Send this prompt in the conversation with the Bot you choose and follow the setup guide.
mail.agentMailboxes.setupPrompt:
Please connect mailbox {{address}} to the current Agent and send me the authorization link. After I approve it, complete the connection automatically. If this Agent does not support mailbox connections, tell me directly.

If the plugin is not installed, use /install first, or run the following command to install it from ClawHub:

openclaw plugins install clawhub:openclaw-octo-mail-plugin

After installation, run:

openclaw octo-mail setup
openclaw octo-mail bind --mailbox {{address}} --agent <agent-id> --space-id {{spaceId}}
mail.agentMailboxes.cliPromptDescription: For Agents that can use a terminal and octo-cli. Copy the prompt so the Agent can install the CLI, verify its identity, and start mailbox authorization.
mail.agentMailboxes.cliSetupPrompt:
Use the official octo-cli to connect mailbox {{address}} to the current Bot and send me the authorization link. After I approve it, follow the octo-mail Skill to finish the connection.

1. Install or upgrade octo-cli:

npm install -g @mininglamp-oss/octo-cli@latest

2. Load the official Mail Skill:

octo-cli skills octo-mail

3. Verify the current mailbox authorization state and Bot identity:

octo-cli mail auth status

4. Start mailbox authorization for the target Space:

octo-cli --space {{spaceId}} mail auth login --mailbox {{address}}
